basis: The manuscript chapter on environment construction, with methodological references separated by their stated scope

topics.title: Rule- and Constraint-Driven Procedural Generation
topics.description: Rules and intermediate structures control roads, buildings, terrain, and natural environments.

topics.title: Asset Retrieval and Compositional Environment Assembly
topics.description: Spatial units and object assets are assembled under layout, connection, and placement constraints.

topics.title: Learning-Based Generation of 3D Structures and Scene Representations
topics.description: Learned distributions generate scene parameters, layouts, voxels, neural fields, or Gaussian representations.

topics.title: 3D Environment Generation with Image and Video Priors
topics.description: Images, panoramas, and videos supply visual priors that are lifted or fused into spatial environments.

topics.title: Geospatial Data- and Map-Driven Structured Reconstruction
topics.description: Georeferenced maps and elevation data establish the structure of a specific site.

topics.title: Explicit Geometry Recovery and Multisensor Fusion
topics.description: Calibrated observations and sensor fusion recover explicit samples, surfaces, and object geometry.

topics.title: Scene Reconstruction with Neural Fields and Gaussian Representations
topics.description: Neural fields and Gaussian representations recover captured outdoor scenes, appearance, and dynamics.

topics.title: Recovering Simulation-Relevant Structures and Properties
topics.description: Recovery extends to persistent surfaces, calibrated facility behavior, and environmental fields.

topics.title: Geometric Completion, Local Repair, and Spatial Expansion
topics.description: Missing regions are completed while preserving alignment with the surrounding environment.

topics.title: Object, Semantic, and Topological Editing
topics.description: Structured scene representations expose object edits, semantic selection, and contextual integration.

topics.title: Transformations of Appearance, Physics, and Environmental Properties
topics.description: Scene variants change illumination, weather, physical properties, or geometry-dependent environmental fields.

topics.title: Hybrid Construction and Automated Orchestration
topics.description: Construction stages are connected through executable tools, intermediate states, and feedback.
